productionEntrances.sourceObservation: Female has two HAIR materials, male has one. Material bindings must be rediscovered after a preset change.
productionEntrances.exportMechanism: Official main calibration is baked to the main texture. Highlight/outline calibration and shader shade retain shader roles. Exact changed resources require export comparison.
productionEntrances.readbackLimit: Bridge base-color getter deliberately returns null. Existing Main/Highlight texture-layer query has a retained partial error. Neither null equality nor partial metadata is cold-open proof.

productionEntrances.api: Fresh Eyebrow group and vroid_set_color; documented key Level1Eyebrow_OverlayColor
productionEntrances.sourceObservation: Separate FaceBrow material and PNG in both avatars. Actual current brow color key was not queried by this task.
productionEntrances.exportMechanism: Native face-part calibration bakes the image; material shader controls are separate.

productionEntrances.api: Fresh linked skin bindings then vroid_set_color; MainColor/ShadowColor/HighlightColor
productionEntrances.sourceObservation: Existing male FaceSkin and BodySkin each expose seven color keys. Official default skin linkage also includes eyelid and nose. Froz color_state exposes shared/alias bindings and rejects overlapping writes.
productionEntrances.exportMechanism: Official native gradient-map calibration bakes light/mid/dark into skin images. Shade/emission/outline material factors are separate.
productionEntrances.unmaskedDerivativeConstraint: Both targets are original-VRM plus native full-Body-PNG derivatives. A skin change requires corresponding clothed and tops-removed native sources under the same settings, then actual RGB/UV/geometry correspondence before regenerating the derivative. Old full PNG cannot silently replace newly calibrated RGB.

productionEntrances.api: Fresh Iris group; vroid_set_color with Level3Iris_LeftOverlayColor and Level3Iris_RightOverlayColor
productionEntrances.sourceObservation: Both actual avatars have independent Iris, EyeWhite and EyeHighlight material/image consumers; Iris main and shade use the same source image.
productionEntrances.exportMechanism: Native overlay calibration bakes the iris image while retaining its authored pattern. Pure black/white preservation is documented, but actual pupil pixels need anatomical and rendered checks.

productionEntrances.api: Discover/apply one legal free Lip item and query its exact overlay/layer binding in a later native sample
productionEntrances.sourceObservation: Neither export has a dedicated Lip material. Existing native Mouth query addresses mouth interior. Existing free Lip catalog entries prove availability only.
productionEntrances.exportMechanism: An authored Lip layer can be composited into Face skin at native export; a separate exported material is not required.
productionEntrances.forbiddenSubstitution: Whole Mouth material tint is not outer-lip color proof

sourceRoles.sourceTextures: Exact encoded and RGBA/RGB pixel SHA, dimensions, samplers, transforms and consumers are in source-inventory.json
sourceRoles.morphs: Each avatar has 14 VRM expressions, no materialColorBinds. Morph channels move surfaces and do not expose source color-production controls.
sourceRoles.runtime: Current exact native source policy supports original colors only. Existing max-channel neutralTexture plus material tint is not native calibration evidence. No runtime admission was changed.

nextMinimumSample.targetPolicy: One explicit moderate color chosen for the sample before writing. No hue or strength sweep.
steps: Verify ready, known file and clean state; save an entry snapshot and new source copy
Fresh-query Iris groups, exact left/right color keys and all original bindings
Set only both iris overlay keys once, retaining original shade/highlight/material values
Save, cold-open and compare actual RGBA readback; export baseline/candidate VRM1 with matched no-reduction settings
Compare actual Iris encoded/pixel change, all non-target images/material fields, geometry/UV/skin/IBM/morphs and eye bones; require source/donor Body unchanged before full-PNG reuse
Restore entering snapshot; record new exact source and output identities
Later root runs common-loader close-view neutral/blink/look checks, pupil/highlight inspection and recipe restore before any new source admission
stopConditions: Pupil/highlight loss or incompatible Body donor

licenseBoundary.assetTerms: Built-in pixiv assets are not CC0. Guideline use permissions, special-item terms and application/output licensing must be reviewed separately from these actual export meta fields.
